about: Paths whose content may legitimately trip a generic privacy rule. Each entry names the generic rules it lifts for the matching files, and why. Matching is case-sensitive and '*' never crosses a '/'. Private rules can never be lifted here. tests/test_privacy_check.py pins these entries, so widening one is a visible change.

paths.why: Third-party license texts must keep their authors' contact addresses unchanged.
Third-party notices must keep their authors' contact addresses unchanged.
The checker defines the private-patterns schema name it looks for.
The README shows the shape of a private-patterns file with a synthetic example.
